d:
From Hanoi to Seoul to Ulaanbaatar After so many years, I’m finally going back to Mongolia!
In this vlog, I wrap up my Vietnam trip in Hanoi and fly with Jeju Air to Seoul, South Korea. From there, I catch my next flight to **Chinggis Khaan International Airport** in Ulaanbaatar. It’s a long way around, but I’ve been looking forward to this one for years.
